Optimize the existing Power BI semantic model for performance and maintainability.

Tasks:
1) Review table design, grain, and relationship graph
2) Identify anti-patterns (many-to-many, ambiguous paths, high-cardinality issues)
3) Propose and prioritize model-level improvements
4) Evaluate DAX hotspots and suggest measure refactors
5) Recommend report-level optimizations (visual count, interaction tuning)

Output:
- Top issues by impact
- Recommended changes with rationale
- Risk/effort estimate
- Validation plan and expected improvement indicators
